newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW - Sweden cuts key interest rates.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Sweden cuts key interest rates.

text.p: Analysts' views after the Swedish Riksbank cuts its deposit and lending rates by 50 basis points and announces a 25-basis point cut in the repo rate next Tuesday to 4.60 percent, breaking the recent pattern of 10 point cuts every second week.
PER WOLMER PETERSEN, DEN DANKSE BANK
"This is quite surprising (the repo rate cut). The most optimistic was maybe a 10-point cut, but the 25 basis point was very surprising to the market.
"The first reaction will be very positive. It will be very positive for the long end.
"It is positive. I can expect it to steepen the yield curve.
It is definitely going to be positive (for bonds)."
